描述_EN: cizhou wares also appealed to japanese taste and found favour in the west in the 20th century. although not as widely exported as other wares, they share features with contemporary korean and middle eastern ceramics. they were seen as ‘popular ’ wares, not fine enough for use at court. cizhou wares are stonewares made all over northern china.
描述_ZN: Cizhou wares也吸引了日本人的兴趣，并在20世纪在西方获得了青睐。 虽然没有像其他器物那样广泛出口，但它们与当代韩国和中东的陶瓷有共同的特点。 它们被认为是 "大众 "的物品，不够精美，不适合在宫廷使用。 在中国北方各地都有贵州器皿。
